meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 接管 git 操作:先输出风格检测和提交计划,再把改动拆成多个原子提交(按目录、依赖顺序分组),并做 rebase/squash、blame/bisect 历史查找。
howto.when: 当你提到 commit、rebase、squash 等关键词,或问「谁写的」「某改动何时加入」「找出引入它的那次提交」时接管。

say.text: 把当前改动拆成多个原子提交
say.note: 先打印风格检测与提交计划,再分组提交

say.text: 帮我把这几个提交 squash 成一个并清理历史
say.note: 仅本地提交时做历史重写

say.text: 找出 login 功能是在哪次提交加入的

howto.what_en: Takes over git work: prints a style-detection and commit plan first, then splits changes into multiple atomic commits grouped by directory and dependency order, and handles rebase/squash plus blame/bisect history lookups.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say commit, rebase, or squash, or ask who wrote a line, when a change was added, or which commit introduced it.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into multiple atomic commits
say_en.note: Prints style detection and commit plan first

say_en.text: Squash these commits into one and clean up the history
say_en.note: Rewrites history only for local commits

say_en.text: Find which commit added the login feature
